title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Issues Concerning Audio and Video Recordings Involved in Criminal Cases of Copyright Infringement

articles.content_en:
For the act of reproducing and distributing sound recordings or video recordings made by others without the permission of the producers thereof for the purpose of profit, the quantity standards for reproductions shall apply respectively the provisions of Item (2) of Paragraph 1 and Item (2) of Paragraph 2 of Article 5 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights.

The act of disseminating, through information networks, the sound recordings or video recordings made by others without the permission of the producers thereof shall be deemed as 'reproduction and distribution' as provided in Item (3) of Article 217 of the Criminal Law.

This is our reply.
